description: Domain-independent principles for scientific validity assessment

principles.name: Data Independence
principles.description: Training, validation, and test data must be mutually exclusive

principles.name: Data Provenance
principles.description: All data sources must be traceable and accessible

principles.name: Comparison Symmetry
principles.description: Methods being compared must be evaluated under identical conditions

principles.name: Selection-Evaluation Separation
principles.description: Model/hyperparameter selection must use held-out data, not test data

principles.name: Scope-Evidence Alignment
principles.description: Claim scope must match the evidence population

principles.name: Aggregation Faithfulness
principles.description: Reported aggregated metrics must match underlying computations

principles.name: Evidence Closure
principles.description: All required evidence for claim verification must be available

principles.name: Statistical Evidence Sufficiency
principles.description: Claims require appropriate statistical evidence (significance, uncertainty)

usage_notes: Each principle must be traceable to paper text or pre-registered ontology
No post-hoc principles allowed after seeing benchmark failures
